messages:
maria: Heads-up: Platform team wants to remove legacy routing header `X-Rd-Route` from public SDKs. Need SDK leads + console/telemetry owners to align on rollout plan.
aj: Is this going to break existing clients? We need a clear shim and deprecation UX.
chris: Server can accept old header and map to v2, but console needs to show both for 2 months so quota attribution doesn't jump. We'll add fields in telemetry: `route_header_version` and `route_header_source`.
sasha: I'll write migration snippets for py/ts/go. Idea: feature flag opt-in first, then warning logs, then removal. Example:
```
# python
client = Redwood(api_key="...")
client.enable_route_v2()  # opt-in before the hard cut
```
leo: devex-bot: canary run for py-sdk shows flake in header parsing when header absent. Filed py#432.
aj: I'll push a tolerant parser and a deprecation logger in Go + TS helpers.
maria: Proposed timeline: announce week 0, opt-in minor release week 1 (with warnings), telemetry sampling for legacy traffic week 3, server-side fallback DRY-RUN week 6, hard remove week 12.
chris: Console work: add a per-tenant metric tile that reports % legacy vs v2 headers and a time-series for attribution deltas. Also add a migration pane that links SDK docs.
sasha: Docs: I'll target PRs for py & ts by EOD and Go by Friday. Which exact telemetry key? `route_header_version` and `route_header_source` sound fine.
aj: Will include a small helper `parseRouteHeader(hdr string) (string, string)` in Go client for consistent attribution.
maria: OK please ack with owner + ETA in this thread. If any teams can't meet the timeline, call it out now so we can adjust the server fallback window.
chris: Ack - console tile ETA 2 weeks, migration job ETA 3 weeks for backfill.
sasha: Ack - py/ts PRs today, go PR Friday.
aj: Ack - parsing helper + opt-in minor next week.
leo: I'll track canary failures and re-run tests after PRs. devex-bot: reminder set for 4 days to check progress.
